law_record.title: Turning on curve or crest of grade prohibited in certain circumstances
law_record.text: A vehicle shall not be turned so as to proceed in the opposite direction upon any curve, or upon the approach to or near the crest of a grade, where such vehicle cannot be seen by the driver of any other vehicle approaching from either direction within 500 feet.

activation_conditions: the subject turns to proceed in the opposite direction
the place is a curve, or the approach to or near the crest of a grade
the subject cannot be seen from 500 feet by a driver approaching from either direction
residue: the 500-foot visibility is a sight-line construction: as good as st.sight_distance on the source, and it must be computed in both directions
summary.subject: driver

timing_requirements.requirement: the manoeuvre is judged where it is made; the visibility test is geometric at that point
